title: DeliveryState match arms are exhaustive — no wildcard that would swallow new variants
description: delivery_state_str in kith-store covers all 4 DeliveryState variants with no _ arm. If a new variant is added, rustc emits a non-exhaustive-match error at compile time. A future contributor might add a _ => unreachable!() arm 'for convenience'. That would make new-variant bugs compile-time invisible. Keep match arms explicit.
